svg.text: HDIP 0.1 — M15-V06: Product Consumption & Consumer Experience (SSCF / CEP)
Governed discovery for consumption or optional creation · Purpose-bound access · Evidence-driven value and evolution
Consumers, entry modes and governed discovery
SSCF — Canonical Eight-Stage Product Consumption Lifecycle (M11)
Lifecycle responsibilities — not eight mandatory synchronous runtime calls
Evaluate Product Fit and Request Access
Existing Product Port; no new Port
Stage 8 may preserve an existing consumption path, trigger adaptation, or intentionally enter PDEP; Productness is never automatic.
Plane Participation — one HDIP architecture, distinct logical responsibilities
CEP — Consumer Experience Projection (P2 discovery + P4 consumption, with P5 feedback)
Two valid outcomes after Discovery and Consumption
Find · access · inspect · query · visualize · continue — no new Product needed
B — Optional, Intentional Product Creation / Evolution
Re-use discovery evidence → PDEP, with separate Product qualification
Versioned / Governed Consumer Artifacts & Evidence (as applicable)
X1–X9 — Cross-Cutting Overlays (orthogonal; apply according to context)
HDIP-FND — Shared Platform / Utility Foundation: enabling technology, not semantic, Product, policy or Decision authority
SSCF stage order ≠ mandatory runtime pipeline.
do not automatically create a Product.
No agent is a new canonical Plane or ABB.
Agency does not imply delegated authority,
when an applicable capability is invoked.
